info.name: UiPath Automation Hub Alerts Digitization API

params.name: projectId
params.description: Unique identifier of the Document Understanding project

params.name: api-version
params.description: API version to use for this request

items.docs: Submits a document for digitization, converting it into a structured digital representation that can be used for classification, extraction, and validation. Supported input formats are JPEG, PNG, PDF, and TIFF. The response includes a documentId that must be used in subsequent classification, extraction, and validation requests. Digitized results are retained for seven days.
